page.overview:
Who is Vildar Blin's brother?

The Alliance to Restore the Republic Special Forces soldier Vildar Blin had a brother who betrayed his family by joining the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order. As a result, Vildar left his post with local security forces on Corulag to join the Rebellion.
